event: Aldous Vren, natural philosopher, has studied the dungeon from outside for fourteen months.
He has copied the ledger-keeper's records, leaving the raw recent deaths alone.
He has held forty-seven interviews and read every account, the contradictions too.
He began thinking the dungeon an organism; now he thinks it a system of classification.
It names what is most irreducibly a person, then has them die by that name: taxonomy.
He has run out of ways to test it from outside.
He packs notebook, charcoal, food, lantern and knife, and leaves his papers with his assistant.
He reaches the camp when the fire is lowest; a young man sleeps near Fennick's empty side.
The ledger-keeper, awake early, says: you told me you were here to observe.
"I was," Aldous says. "Now I'm here to enter."
The ledger-keeper writes: voluntary, non-Compelled, natural philosopher, research.
He added that column three days ago, after Fennick Rall.
Aldous rereads his notes for an hour and maps the camp in his margin.
He looks at Petra's note on the blank cloth; he interviewed her seventeen days ago.
He writes: P. entered and did not return. F.R. entered and did not return.
At dawn he walks to the entrance and goes in.
He adds what no source mentioned: the light pulses irregularly, and the ribs point inward.
He reads the registry against his records: Edric Voss, Death #1, calm, says a witness.
He reads all ten inscriptions and stands before the blank gap.
He knows the gap is Orvyn's: his record is the journal, not the wall.
The gap precedes Sera's entry: the wall is ordered by precedence, not by date.
Each inscription is a category: the dungeon records distinctions, not deaths.
Confirmation does not move him as he expected, and he notes that too.
By a side passage he crouches over Asha Trevane's glass bead without touching it.
He notes: intentional deposit, undisturbed; the dungeon tolerates personal deposits.
At the arch he finds Renn's dimensions accurate and the joints too tight for a finger.
The keystone is in the dungeon's notation: Renn built it, and the dungeon chose to record it.
The lantern burns at the abutment, its oil recently tended.
He writes: the arch is meaningful to the dungeon; not a classification system. Revise.
He crosses the arch. The Ledger: Depth 2, the Warrens, Resolve +1, now 22.

changes.note: Depth transition into the Warrens, Resolve +1

event: The Asking finds him at the first junction, and it is like becoming understanding.
Fourteen months he studied it; it studies him back for about three seconds.
The Ledger names him The Lens, with the Gift Comprehension: any system, understood at once.
Its Cost is Friction: he has lost not-understanding, so danger cannot register as danger.
The Ledger reads Vitality 8, Resolve 21, Attunement 18, Fortune 22.
Second voluntary entrant: The Maw did not bring him here either.
He writes: the dungeon has named the thing I have managed for thirty years.
Either is relational: the dungeon knows Rall, and draws a line between them.
Comprehension opens the Warrens to him as water's long argument with limestone.
He takes down Orvyn Thel's journal and reads it as a field record, noting method and gaps.
He writes that the last entry is a relay: the journal is infrastructure, not memoir.
He sets it back at the same angle: a fixed point, like the arch and the bead.
In the pattern room he understands Thel's repetitions as method, not failure.
He has worked this way thirty years and never seen it from outside.
He stands there longer than anywhere else, writing nothing, and goes on.
In the Still Garden Comprehension shows him the crystals' function and the engineered silence.
The Patient shows itself at the end of a row, so he will orient on it and then look away.
He walks past it deliberately, keeping it in the corner of his eye.
He understands it moves in the saccade, the gap no watching can close.
At the third row a refraction he has no category for snags his attention for a moment.
He feels the tracking shift, and keeps moving without looking at the crystal.
He notes: attention-gap sensitivity sub-second. Do not look at anything.
At the far wall Comprehension finds the passage to Depth 4, one the eye would miss.
He looks at The Patient, and The Patient looks at him.
The Ledger: Depth 3, Resolve +1, now 23.

changes.note: Depth transition into the Still Garden, Resolve +1

event: He goes through. The Ledger: Depth 4, the Crucible, Resolve +1, now 24: the first to reach it.

changes.note: Depth transition into the Crucible, Resolve +1

event: Basalt veined with quartz, the floor twelve degrees warmer than the Garden above.
Quartz stalactites hang in no pattern: the first room that will not yield its logic at once.
Moving in, he sees it is a process, not a place: the quartz accumulates; it is making something.
At the centre sits a creature, anchored in quartz grown round it over ages.
It exhales a slow emanation he feels as pressure behind his eyes.
He writes: not a predator; the emanation is the death mechanism; I am inside its radius.
The discomfort began thirty meters back, unregistered, because the Cost took the fear.
He notes: threshold exceeded; forty meters to retreat; eight to twelve minutes to incapacity.
He looks up: the quartz scatters the lantern like mountain caves after a winter storm.
He notes the light, the formation, the chemistry, and the rate of growth.
He is still writing when the lantern goes out.

changes.note: Aldous dies of the Crucible creature's emanation, Vitality to 0

event: The death report: Aldous Vren, the Lens, Depth 4, the Crucible; emanation, accumulative.
Attunement stays 18: Comprehension is effortless, and leaves no trace of effort.
He knew the mechanism, threshold and window, and went on taking notes.
His Memory Crystal is white: clarity without friction, understanding and feeling nothing.
No Floor Mutation, but his notebook remains. Lens complete.
The Maw sees a pattern: two voluntary entrants in sequence, for reasons all their own.
It had known of Vren, and waited without Compelling him to see whether he would come.
He came.
It judges his hypothesis approximately correct, but incomplete.
He was near the rest when he stopped to look at the light on the quartz.
The tally turns: 988 remain.
ALDOUS VREN — DEPTH 4 — FIRST TO COMPREHEND.
